data.one_liner: Add hex color codes and convert material colors to hex in Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to instantiate Flutter Color objects using hexadecimal string codes (such as #009688) and provides an extension to convert material colors to hex strings.
use_when: You need to define colors using hex strings in Flutter projects
You want to convert existing Material Color instances into hex strings
avoid_when: You prefer using standard Flutter hex color notation (e.g., 0xFF009688) without an external package
strengths: Simple API for hex string color parsing
Supports converting Material colors to hex strings via extension
weaknesses: Redundant with native Flutter color initialization (Color(0xFF...))
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:hexcolor/hexcolor.dart';

Text("Hello There!", style: TextStyle(color: HexColor("#009688")));
